parties.petitioner: Balkrishna Rama Tarle Dead Through Lrs & Anr.

summary: Petitioners, tenants claiming rights in mortgaged property, challenged High Court's order setting aside designated authority's decision under SARFAESI Act. High Court held designated authority exceeded jurisdiction by requiring secured creditor to terminate tenancy before possession could be granted. Supreme Court examined scope of Section 14 SARFAESI Act powers, confirming High Court's view that District Magistrate cannot impose preconditions like tenancy termination before assisting secured creditor in asset possession.
legal_provisions_cited: Harshad Govardhan Sondagar Vs. International Assets Reconstruction Company Limited and Ors. (2014) 6 SCC 1
Vishal N. Kalsaria Vs. Bank of India and Ors. (2016) 3 SCC 762
final_judgment: Special Leave Petition dismissed, upholding High Court's order to set aside designated authority's conditional decision and directing fresh disposal of Section 14 application according to law.
